title: feat: CKO_CERTIFICATE objects from PIV cert slots
description: PIV cards store an X.509 certificate alongside each private key (slots 9A/9C/9D/9E). Most PKCS#11 consumers — ssh-agent, curl --cert, OpenSSL pkeyutl, pkcs11-tool — do C_FindObjects for CKO_CERTIFICATE and require one to be present. Without certificate objects wolfP11 silently fails with a large class of real applications. This epic fetches PIV certificate data objects via GET DATA (OIDs 5FC105/5FC10A/5FC10B/5FC101) and surfaces them as CKO_CERTIFICATE objects in C_FindObjects, with CKA_VALUE returning the DER-encoded certificate.
